items.name: AmazonS3Builder
items.summary: Configure a connection to Amazon S3 using the specified credentials in the specified Amazon region and bucket.

methods.name: build
methods.summary: Create a [`AmazonS3`] instance from the provided values, consuming `self`.

methods.name: from_env
methods.summary: Fill the [`AmazonS3Builder`] with regular AWS environment variables

methods.name: get_config_value
methods.summary: Get config value via a [`AmazonS3ConfigKey`].

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Create a new [`AmazonS3Builder`] with default values.

methods.name: with_access_key_id
methods.signature: fn with_access_key_id(self, access_key_id: impl Into<String>) -> Self
methods.summary: Set the AWS Access Key

methods.name: with_allow_http
methods.summary: Sets what protocol is allowed.

methods.name: with_bucket_key
methods.summary: Set whether to enable bucket key for server side encryption. This overrides the bucket default setting for bucket keys.

methods.name: with_bucket_name
methods.signature: fn with_bucket_name(self, bucket_name: impl Into<String>) -> Self
methods.summary: Set the bucket_name (required)

methods.name: with_checksum_algorithm
methods.summary: Sets the [checksum algorithm] which has to be used for object integrity check during upload.

methods.name: with_client_options
methods.summary: Sets the client options, overriding any already set

methods.name: with_conditional_put
methods.summary: Configure how to provide conditional put operations. if not set, the default value will be `S3ConditionalPut::ETagMatch`

methods.name: with_config
methods.signature: fn with_config(self, key: AmazonS3ConfigKey, value: impl Into<String>) -> Self
methods.summary: Set an option on the builder via a key - value pair.

methods.name: with_copy_if_not_exists
methods.summary: Configure how to provide `copy_if_not_exists`

methods.name: with_credentials
methods.summary: Set the credential provider overriding any other options

methods.name: with_disable_tagging
methods.summary: If set to `true` will ignore any tags provided to [`put_opts`](crate::ObjectStore::put_opts)

methods.name: with_dsse_kms_encryption
methods.signature: fn with_dsse_kms_encryption(self, kms_key_id: impl Into<String>) -> Self
methods.summary: Use dual server side encryption for server side encryption.

methods.name: with_endpoint
methods.signature: fn with_endpoint(self, endpoint: impl Into<String>) -> Self
methods.summary: Sets the endpoint for communicating with AWS S3.

methods.name: with_http_connector
methods.signature: fn with_http_connector<C: HttpConnector>(self, connector: C) -> Self
methods.summary: The [`HttpConnector`] to use

methods.name: with_imdsv1_fallback
methods.summary: By default instance credentials will only be fetched over [IMDSv2], as AWS recommends against having IMDSv1 enabled on EC2 instances as it is vulnerable to [SSRF attack]

methods.name: with_metadata_endpoint
methods.signature: fn with_metadata_endpoint(self, endpoint: impl Into<String>) -> Self
methods.summary: Set the [instance metadata endpoint](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-instance-metadata.html), used primarily within AWS EC2.

methods.name: with_proxy_ca_certificate
methods.signature: fn with_proxy_ca_certificate(self, proxy_ca_certificate: impl Into<String>) -> Self
methods.summary: Set a trusted proxy CA certificate

methods.name: with_proxy_excludes
methods.signature: fn with_proxy_excludes(self, proxy_excludes: impl Into<String>) -> Self
methods.summary: Set a list of hosts to exclude from proxy connections

methods.name: with_proxy_url
methods.signature: fn with_proxy_url(self, proxy_url: impl Into<String>) -> Self
methods.summary: Set the proxy_url to be used by the underlying client

methods.name: with_region
methods.signature: fn with_region(self, region: impl Into<String>) -> Self
methods.summary: Set the region, defaults to `us-east-1`

methods.name: with_request_payer
methods.summary: Set whether to charge requester for bucket operations.

methods.name: with_retry
methods.summary: Set the retry configuration

methods.name: with_s3_express
methods.summary: Configure this as an S3 Express One Zone Bucket

methods.name: with_secret_access_key
methods.signature: fn with_secret_access_key(self, secret_access_key: impl Into<String>) -> Self
methods.summary: Set the AWS Secret Access Key

methods.name: with_skip_signature
methods.summary: If enabled, [`AmazonS3`] will not fetch credentials and will not sign requests

methods.name: with_sse_kms_encryption
methods.signature: fn with_sse_kms_encryption(self, kms_key_id: impl Into<String>) -> Self
methods.summary: Use SSE-KMS for server side encryption.

methods.name: with_ssec_encryption
methods.signature: fn with_ssec_encryption(self, customer_key_base64: impl Into<String>) -> Self
methods.summary: Use SSE-C for server side encryption. Must pass the *base64-encoded* 256-bit customer encryption key.

methods.name: with_token
methods.signature: fn with_token(self, token: impl Into<String>) -> Self
methods.summary: Set the AWS Session Token to use for requests

methods.name: with_unsigned_payload
methods.summary: Sets if unsigned payload option has to be used.

methods.name: with_url
methods.signature: fn with_url(self, url: impl Into<String>) -> Self
methods.summary: Parse available connection info form a well-known storage URL.

methods.name: with_virtual_hosted_style_request
methods.summary: Sets if virtual hosted style request has to be used.
